name: Falafel Bento Box with Hummus, Pita Bread & Greek Salad (Prep-Ahead)

instructions.primary_message: This recipe utilizes a 2-compartment bento box. Please adjust the recipe as needed to accommodate the size of your bento box or food storage containers.

Place falafel mix and water in a small bowl; stir to combine, then set aside to hydrate for 30-60 minutes. (This recipe was tested with Tarazi falafel mix and will yield 5 falafel; please double-check package instructions as quantities and timing may vary across different brands.)
Once the falafel mix is hydrated, preheat oven to 350°F. Line a baking sheet pan with parchment paper, then coat with thin layer of cooking spray.

While the oven is heating, using a rounded tablespoon measure, form the falafel mixture into 5 balls. Transfer to the baking sheet and lightly press on each ball to make small patties. Spray the tops with another thin layer of cooking spray.

Place baking sheet in the preheated oven and bake, flipping falafel halfway through, until golden and crispy on both sides, about 25 minutes (or cook according to package instructions). Remove from oven and let cool completely.
Meanwhile, wash, dry, trim, and halve cucumber lengthwise, then cut crosswise into thin half-moons. Place in another small bowl.
Wash, dry, and halve tomatoes. Add to the bowl with the cucumber.
Halve olives. Cut feta into bite-sized pieces. Add both to the bowl, then gently stir to combine the salad.
instructions.secondary_message:
¼ cup Kalamata olives, pitted
57 g feta cheese

instructions.primary_message: Transfer salad to the medium compartment of the bento box. Place dressing in a small container with a lid and add to the box.
Cut pita into wedges. Place in the large compartment of the bento box, along with cooled falafel and hummus.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 white pita bread
1 (57 g) snack cup hummus

instructions.primary_message: Cover bento box and refrigerate until ready to eat. If desired, falafel may be warmed up in the oven or microwave right before eating. Enjoy!
